_comment: Records WHICH key may sign a release; it holds no key and signs nothing. A card-backed private
key is never exportable, so it can never be a build secret: ciSigning stays false and CI publishes
unsigned builds. state 'Unconfigured' means no certificate was acquired, and the signing script
refuses then. Never invent a thumbprint, a signer name or a validity date here.
provider: Certum SimplySign (Open Source Code Signing in the Cloud) - not purchased

notes.hashes: a signature appends to the file, so every published SHA-256 is taken after signing
notes.licence: signing adds no restriction: GPL-3.0-only, and a rebuilt binary is unsigned
